# Novaro Solution

Novaro Solution is a software studio in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India. It designs and ships custom software for companies in the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, the Middle East, and India. There is no office in the United States. Clients work remotely with the Gandhinagar studio.

Founded: 2024
Studio: 707, Capitol Icon, Swagat Reliance Road, Sargasan, Gandhinagar, Gujarat 382419, India
Hours: Monday–Saturday, 10:00–19:00 IST (this covers the US East morning)
Email: novaro@novarosolution.com
Phone: +91 96244 98325
Website: https://www.novarosolution.com

## What it builds

- Web applications and mobile products (Next.js, React, Node.js)
- AI features in production apps (document extraction, search, review queues)
- Digital marketing and technical SEO
- Cloud, DevOps, and design systems

Industries: D2C and e-commerce, logistics, healthcare services, fintech and SaaS, education.

Public figures on the site: 2 years shipping production software, 32+ clients, 50+ products and platforms.

## How a project starts

Send a short brief. Novaro books a 30-minute discovery call, then sends a written proposal with scope, timeline, and price within 2–3 business days. Weekly demos. One team from discovery to launch.
